mapper.insert: INSERT INTO uploaded_asset (id, owner_user_id, original_filename, stored_path, public_url, mime_type, size_bytes, width, height, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{ownerUserId}, #{originalFilename}, #{storedPath}, #{publicUrl}, #{mimeType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{width}, #{height}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_user_id, original_filename, stored_path, public_url, mime_type, size_bytes, width, height, created_at FROM uploaded_asset WHERE id = #{id}
